sourceFacts: Non-exact description text is sent as a POST body to the Lupi Cloudflare discovery endpoint and then to TypeSafe.
The discovery route has no application database write, cache write or console logging of the query.
The shared TypeSafe client constructs its own service-authentication headers and does not deliberately forward the app caller IP, cookies, account UID or device identifier.
Wrangler contains no explicit observability/logging configuration; this does not establish that live logging is disabled.

retention.providerPolicySummary: TypeSafe states customer Input is not used to train models and describes purpose-based retention. Enterprise ZDR is an available option; no Lupi-specific ZDR agreement or fixed deletion SLA was verified.
retention.importantDistinction: No-training, no application query log and no-store response caching do not establish zero retention.
